gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-karma: Karma is a gentle serif, its strokes never snagging the eye. JetBrains Mono earns its keep big and brief, its fixed-width code letters ending in terminals that part like open scissor blades.
gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads clean, its tall, sturdy lowercase making words look large. And JetBrains Mono supplies the standout quality, its loose, fixed-width, rounded-wire letters setting a code-flavored texture against all that sturdiness.
gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-paquito: Flat lines, fixed widths, no fuss: JetBrains Mono sets the tone. Paquito, a confident serif, keeps lowercase and capitals close in height, so pages of it would feel friendly and sure-footed.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-domine: Dignified, with compact ascenders and breathing room inside every curve, Domine is a serif of soft contrast. After JetBrains Mono's flat strokes, Domine's text would settle into a warm rhythm.
gen-jetbrains-mono-montserrat: JetBrains Mono sets fixed-width, loosely strung letters up top. Montserrat, a geometric sans with generous white space before each curve, glides along like wire, so paragraphs would flow easily.
gen-jetbrains-mono-mulish: Mulish is a modern sans drawn with no stroke contrast, a large x-height and apertures open like a horseshoe magnet. Paragraphs of it would slide by smoothly beneath JetBrains Mono's fixed-width heads.
gen-jetbrains-mono-switzer: Loose code letters over tidy, tubular Swiss forms. Switzer, a plain sans with wire-like strokes and a tall waist line, gives JetBrains Mono's loosely strung characters a tidy, approachable partner.
gen-kaushan-script-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space at its curve ends. Kaushan Script brings a bold, relaxed calligraphic hand against that sharpness, though the pair isn't built for extended paragraphs.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space between curve ends and stems, and a moderate lowercase height. Luckiest Guy, cheerful and loud, shouts over it with a high mean line.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-hoover: Hoover, a refined, robust text serif, lets the e's eye open generously. Hoover keeps its ascenders compressed, leaving Luckiest Guy, with its pipe-cleaner strokes, to earn its keep big and brief.
